meta.title: External system connections
meta.description: Manage external system connections (MCP) from a sidebar panel: add, edit, enable, disable, delete, and test. Supports stdio, SSE, and streamable HTTP; custom request headers; browser login capture that saves the authentication headers automatically; custom CA certificates or a verification opt-out for self-signed HTTPS; and automatic credential refresh with one retry after a 401. Captured secrets stay in the credential store and are never shown or logged in clear text. Login capture works best on same-origin login pages; cross-origin SSO, service workers, and WebSockets may limit capture, and a session without a refresh token must sign in again after expiry.
